name: Summit AZ - SEO AEO Audit 2026-06-23
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-06-23

# Summary
Read-only SEO/AEO audit and prioritized fix list for the Arizona site by the local-seo-auditor agent. States the Utah site (summitplumbingut.com) is a different, non-client site and was not touched. Site judged structurally healthy: GSC 98 indexed, 16 not indexed; sitemap index valid (page-sitemap 152 URLs, post-sitemap 6); robots.txt clean. Platform at the time: WordPress, Elementor, Yoast, SiteGround SuperCacher, `summit-location-seo` mu-plugin.

# Already shipped (verified live)
- mu-plugin emits Plumber + Service (+ FAQPage where `_summit_faqs_cache` is set) on city-service pages, NAP 950 W. Birchwood Ave Ste 12, Mesa AZ 85210.
- H1 defects fixed (pipe lining, tankless, water softener); wrong canonicals on three water heater pages fixed; FAQ schema now matches visible content on general plumbing pages.
- Title trims only partially shipped. DNI pool numbers are intentional GHL tracking.

# Findings
- P0: none.
- P1-1: `/expert-drain-line-services/` and `/phoenix-plumbing/` are intentional canonical duplicates; stop requesting indexing (wasted quota on 6/16), optionally 301 them after checking Ads links.
- P1-2: homepage has no Plumber/LocalBusiness schema or NAP; extend the mu-plugin without duplicating Yoast's Organization.
- P1-3: lowercase title on tankless Chandler; 81-char double-city titles on Apache Junction and Fountain Hills general plumbing.
- P1-4: all 10 general plumbing city pages and the homepage lack a visible FAQ; local-entity density is 0 to 1.
- P2: no llms.txt; remaining long titles; single-author archive exposed; start the FAQ rollout on general-plumbing-services-chandler; purge SuperCacher and Yoast indexables after every change.

# Files in this folder
- `summit-pages-audit.csv`: 114-row per-page audit (title and meta length, H1 count, FAQ visible vs schema, LocalBusiness and Service schema, canonical, issue flags such as DUP-TITLE).
- `summit_title_trims.tsv`: 36 post IDs with trimmed titles; `summit_titles.sh` applied them.
- `summit_aeo_audit.md`: see [Summit AZ - AEO Audit Chandler Pages 2026-05-29](lib:brain-summit-az-aeo-audit-chandler-pages-2026-05-29); its schema lines are marked stale here.
- `aeo_geo_seo_audit.py`: the audit script.
